BiblicalUsage: An extremity is the end of a thing: ask from the one side of heaven unto the other whether there hath been any such thing; Samuel said to Saul, bid the servant pass on before us, but stand thou still a while; and the lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, and behold, there was no man there.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the ends as the measure of wonder and of mercy: no wonder has ever reached from one end of heaven to the other, and the lepers found an empty camp at the far end.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
